correctness.rationale: In discrete neutral birth–death Moran dynamics, including self-transitions, reciprocal-degree mutant weight W(S)=sum_{v in S}1/d_v is a martingale: edgewise replacement probabilities cancel. Optional stopping gives p(S)=W(S)/W(V). For every connected undirected simple graph of n<=4, independently constructed exact-rational Q on nonabsorbing mutant subsets, solved (I-Q)m=p and tau=m/p; enumerated 1,4,38 connected labeled graphs at n=2,3,4 and found qualifying counts 0,0,15. Exactly P4 (12 labelings) and C4 (3) qualify. Witnesses: P4 pairs {0,1},{0,2}, both p=1/2 with conditional times 20 and 15; C4 adjacent and opposite pairs both p=1/2, times 8 and 7. No extrapolation beyond four vertices.
